profile.headline: 💻 Senior Software Engineer  | 🎓 Master's in Computer Engineering | 🏆 Proven Management Success | 🤖 Passion for Tech & Innovation | 🌍 Transforming Digital Landscapes
profile.summary:
👋 Hello! I'm a Senior Full Stack Engineer with a strong background in management and product development. With a Master's degree in Computer Engineering from Iowa State University, I have spent over a decade refining my skills and contributing to the success of various organizations. 🎓

💪 As a results-driven professional, I have a proven track record of developing and implementing innovative software solutions that drive business growth. My experience spans across multiple domains, including frontend and backend development, platform architecture, and site reliability. 🛠️

🤝 I'm passionate about collaborating with cross-functional teams and fostering a culture of mutual respect and continuous learning. I take pride in my ability to build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, scalable solutions that meet and exceed expectations. 🌉

🏆 My engineering expertise is backed by a solid foundation in management, product ownership, and leadership. I've successfully led teams, mentored junior engineers, and contributed to the development of comprehensive product roadmaps, always striving to create a positive and inclusive work environment. 🌟

🚀 Some of the technologies and tools I've mastered include HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Java, Spring ecosystem, Git, JIRA, Bootstrap, React, jQuery, Docker, PostgreSQL, Node.js, TypeScript, GitHub, DevOps, AWS, Kubernetes, Datadog, Jenkins, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Hibernate, Prisma, Redis, Apache Solr, and Kubernetes. 💼

🌱 My passion lies in building innovative solutions and using my management, product, and leadership skills to enhance the core tenants of good engineering. I'm always eager to learn new technologies and stay ahead in the rapidly evolving world of software development. 🧠

🤖 If you're looking for an experienced full stack engineer with a strong desire to collaborate, grow, and drive technical excellence, let's connect! I look forward to sharing my passion for building solutions and contributing significantly to the success of your organization. 🌟

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Kansas City, Missouri, United States · Remote
positions.description:
As a Software Engineer at Adva Digital Solutions, my role involves collaborating with Product Owners (PO) and Project Managers (PM) to plan, coordinate, and execute custom software solutions delivery. I work closely with fellow engineers to select the most suitable tooling and technologies while writing and maintaining high-quality code primarily in a Nest.JS and Next.JS ecosystem. 🛠️🚀 I actively contribute to ensuring code quality and maintainability through regular code reviews. Meeting with clients to help shape the solutions being implemented and researching and recommending technical approaches for upcoming and ongoing contracts are also essential parts of my role. 🤝🌐

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: In my tenure as an Engineering Manager at RFP360, I successfully interviewed and hired additional engineering resources, while managing a diverse team of engineers and QA professionals. I worked closely with product owners, internal stakeholders, and external stakeholders to define and shape the product roadmap. 🛣️💡 I was responsible for breaking down roadmap items into smaller units of work for the engineering team to execute against, as well as planning, documenting, and maintaining new system architectures. I responded to procurement questionnaires, primarily relating to platform security, and monitored, maintained, and ensured platform health and reliability. 🏗️🔒

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: As Principal Software Engineer at RFP360, I took part in interviewing and hiring additional engineering resources and assisted the CTO with interviewing, hiring, and onboarding efforts. I planned incremental migration of the front-end conversion from JSP, Bootstrap, and jQuery to a hybrid legacy + React application. 🔄💻 I diligently monitored, maintained, and improved site reliability, and reviewed code contributions from other team members. I took pride in teaching and mentoring engineers at all levels to help them grow and excel in their roles. 👨‍🏫👩‍💻

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: During my time as a Senior Software Engineer at RFP360, I collaborated with internal and external stakeholders to define innovative solutions. I thrived in an autonomous, fast-paced environment where decisions were frequently made without hierarchical input. I wrote clean, maintainable, and scalable code primarily in a Spring MVC, Bootstrap, and jQuery stack. 🛠️💡 I was responsible for monitoring, maintaining, and improving site reliability, as well as overhauling platform architecture from statically allocated infrastructure to Kubernetes (EKS and AKS). I documented and implemented a path for the adoption of React to enhance the platform's capabilities. 🌐🔧

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: At Cerner, my role involved developing an iOS native application for a sports healthcare & management platform. I built and maintained backend services using Java with Spring Boot, and frontend applications with Ruby on Rails, Bootstrap, and jQuery. 📱🌐 This experience allowed me to hone my skills in various technologies and contribute significantly to the development of a valuable sports healthcare management tool. 🏥🎯🚀
